ui_bugs.issue: After mouse-drawing on signature-capture-canvas and clicking signature-capture-save, the UI shows a success toast but the backend occasionally does not receive the PNG (contact.images.signature stayed {}). File upload path works reliably. Likely cause: canvas.toBlob returns null when the stroke was drawn with only move events (no touch dispatch) and the dirty flag was set but no pixels were committed, OR the pointer events were fired outside the canvas bounding rect after CSS scaling (canvas internal 600x180 vs CSS h-28 w-md). Reproduce by scripting mouse.down / move / up at display-pixel coords. Consider: (1) use pointer-events, (2) fall back to canvas.toDataURL + fetch when toBlob rejects, (3) run blob null check before setting dirty=false.

rca of the issue: SignatureCapture.saveDrawn calls canvas.current.toBlob(cb,'image/png'). When the Playwright-synthesized mouse events don't commit any raster strokes (e.g., when move handler's e.preventDefault keeps default from firing but the browser hasn't flushed stroke paths before toBlob), the blob is null and the promise rejects via rej(new Error('Draw a signature first')) — but because run() catches the error and shows toast.error only if the reject actually surfaces, a race on dirty=true + null blob can momentarily show success before the empty-blob path triggers. File-upload path bypasses this and works 100%. Fix: assert blob != null before upload, or always use canvas.toDataURL() → fetch to avoid toBlob async null edge cases.
